title: KickTodo simulation verdict
description: The typed verdict a Challenge Factory simulation persona returns after walking a candidate plan (ADR 0458 P2). READ-ONLY advisory for the factory's evaluation stage — it commits NO domain state; the creator decides what to change and any revision rides the governed KickTodo Creator surfaces. Closed-world: a sim that cannot produce this exact shape is a typed failure, never success-with-empty.

verdict.description: The persona's overall judgement of the plan: `pass` (livable as-is), `flag` (usable but with concerns worth the creator's attention), `block` (a defect a participant like this persona could not get past).

findings.description: Zero or more specific findings. May be empty (a clean pass); an empty array is a positive statement, not an omission.

day.description: The plan day the finding is about, when it is day-specific.

severity.description: How serious this finding is for this persona: `note` (minor), `flag` (concern), `block` (a stopper).

text.description: The finding in plain language, from the persona's point of view.

personaSummary.description: A short plain-language summary of how the plan felt to this persona overall — what worked and what would make or break it for them.
